# Howling Heaven Studio

> Howling Heaven Studio is an independent digital studio that designs and ships browser games, visual novels, character tools, and AI chat products.

The studio offers visual novel production, character-driven chatbot applications, custom web development, and tailored AI solutions. Original releases run in the browser. Contact: gdulahan@gmail.com

## Products

- [BeastForge](https://beastforge.howlingheaven.com/): Beastman character generator and portrait studio for RPG developers. Nine species, expression morphs, gear layers, and export-ready portraits.
- [Three Souls, One Heart](https://threesouls.howlingheaven.com/): Furry fantasy visual novel. Four chapters and an epilogue, five endings, three hearts to win.
- [Beastmen Masseur](https://masseur.howlingheaven.com/): Cozy, body-positive massage clinic simulation and visual novel set at the Paw & Leaf Clinic in Saltmarrow Harbor.
- [BeastBar](https://beastbar.howlingheaven.com/): Bartending simulation and visual novel at The Velvet Paw in rainy Emberwick, across a 12-night season.
- [Combo Quest](https://combo.howlingheaven.com/): Retro browser RPG with tabletop-style storytelling, 2.5D exploration, and turn-based battles driven by WASD combo inputs.
- [Howly.ai](https://howly.howlingheaven.com/): Persistent-memory roleplay chatbot for original characters and ongoing conversations.
- [VideoFetcher](https://vidfetcher.howlingheaven.com/): Web tool that reads HTML5, Open Graph, JSON-LD, and streaming manifests to extract and play video streams.
- [Fubble Rivals](https://fubble.howlingheaven.com/): Competitive bubble-shooting duel with animal champions, CPU matches, and private two-player rooms.

## Services

- Visual novels: branching narrative, character and scene art, choice-driven engines, audio, and cross-platform publishing. Tools include Ren'Py, Unreal Engine, Unity, and custom web frameworks.
- Chatbot applications: character personas, long-term memory, real-time streaming interfaces, and community bots.
- Web development: Next.js and Three.js applications, design systems, and Cloudflare deployment.
- AI solutions: custom retrieval knowledge bases, workflow agents, API integrations, and analytics.
